newsitem.title: USA: Merrimac posts record sales in 2nd quarter.
newsitem.headline: Merrimac posts record sales in 2nd quarter.

text.p: Merrimac Industries Inc said Tuesday it posted record sales of $4.98 million in the second quarter, up 27 percent over the same period last year.
The company said its order back-log stood at $9.7 million at the end of the second quarter, 18 percent more than the $8.2 million back-log at the end of 1996.
Merrimac posted a $278,000 net income, or $0.18 a share, on sales of $4.3 million in the first quarter. Its stock hit a new 52-week high of 13-1/4 Tuesday at noon, up 7/8.
